September 21, 2026


## Reuniting sea and shore in a virtual space to learn, inspire and engage.


Every year, our Virtual Senior Officers Conference brings together colleagues from across the globe to learn, connect and share ideas. While separated by oceans and time zones, this event creates an opportunity for our Teekay family across sea and shore to come together in one virtual space.


This year’s theme, **Reinforcing Excellence, The Teekay Way** , highlights our commitment to accountability, continuous learning and an ownership mindset. More than a set of processes, The Teekay Way is how we work together to deliver excellence.


Watch the recap to revisit the highlights and celebrate what makes Teekay successful.
